qualification.details: System Admin: B.E./B. Tech. in Computer/IT/ M Sc. (IT/CS) or M.C.A or higher from a recognized university. Minimum of 5+ years hands-on working experience in Windows/Linux Must be proficient in Windows/Linux, Operating System Management, Apache, tomcat. Graphic Designer: Graduate with Diploma/Certificate courses in Graphic Designing/ Multi-Media/ Video Creation/Editing. At least 2+ years of post-qualification experiences as Graphic Designer.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for NCDC Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.ncdc.mohfw.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 16-10-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.ncdc.mohfw.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC) for filling various vacant posts on a contract basis in Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under NCDC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for the positions of System Admin and Graphic Designer in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for NCDC posts?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of the offline application form is 16-10-2026. Candidates must ensure their application reaches the designated address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for NCDC jobs?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly offline. Candidates need to fill out the application form and send it via speed post or submit it by hand.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for System Admin?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E./B. Tech in Computer/IT, M.Sc. (IT/CS), M.C.A or higher along with relevant hands-on working experience in Windows/Linux environments.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for a Graphic Designer?
faq.answer: Applicants must be graduates with diploma or certificate courses in Graphic Designing, Multi-Media, Video Creation, or Editing, plus relevant post-qualification work experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for NCDC recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants applying for the System Admin and Graphic Designer positions is not exceeding 45 years.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for System Admin?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the System Admin post will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 75,000/-.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary offered for a Graphic Designer?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Graphic Designer post will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 45,000/-.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the completed application form be sent?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the General Services Section, Room No. 202, NCDC, 22 - Sham Nath Marg, Delhi - 110054 on or before the due date.
